definitions: A wooden crosspiece that is fastened over the necks of two animals and attached to the plough or cart that they are to pull.
A device for joining a pair of draught animals, especially oxen, at the head or neck for working together.
A part of a garment that fits over the shoulders and to which the main part of the garment is attached.
A control column in an aircraft, used to control the elevators and ailerons.
A state of subjection or servitude.
examples: A pair of oxen were harnessed to a yoke.
The yoke of oppression was finally lifted.
She wore a dress with a decorative yoke.
The pilot gripped the yoke firmly.
